The structure of Sc6B4C2 (reduced formula Sc3BC) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies two main carbon environments: one carbon center with 14 geometric neighbors (2 B, 12 Sc) and another with only one B neighbor, while boron centers show 4 Sc neighbors and Sc centers show 14 neighbors (1 B, 5 C, 8 Sc). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Sc 14-vertex polyhedra and between B 4-vertex polyhedra, with additional corner and edge sharing among C polyhedra.
